body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST -->

<!-- used for reporting Bugs that have replication steps. -->

<!--- Provide a general summary of the issue in the Title above -->

## Platform
<!-- Please fill out the following information about your bug report. -->
<!-- If you are on Linux and installed using a package, please list the package type. -->
Operating system and version: Windows 10
OBS Studio version: 26.1.1 (64 bit)

## Expected Behavior
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
When an image with a fille extension which is in capitals is dropped into the window it should show up.

## Current Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior. -->
<!--- Please include a log file here if possible. -->
Currently when an image with a capitalised file extension is dropped nothing is shown on screen.

## Steps to Reproduce
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant. -->
<!--- Screenshots and video are encouraged if applicable. -->
1. Rename an image file to use capitals for the file extension
2. Drop image onto screen
3.
4.

## Additional information
<!--- Not obligatory, but provide any additional details or information -->
<!--- that you feel might be relevant to the issue -->
The file extensions  [1] are not being santitised [2] . After looking at the code, I also tried it with a video with the extension renamed to use caps, this video failed to load yet using small casing it loads. 
Three possible fixes for this issue which I assume effects all media types. One possilbility is to include the upper cap version in the array of extensions, second it to sanitise the extension before the strcmp. However the issue with this is that the code using a pointer to constant char so a copy would need to be made and then sanitised. Thirdly to use a platform specific function (POSIX strcasecmp, MS stricmp) to compare the extensions.

[1] https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/cab32e7e67c2a78d10e0961f746ee7408978fb43/UI/window-basic-main-dropfiles.cpp#L17
[2] https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/blob/cab32e7e67c2a78d10e0961f746ee7408978fb43/UI/window-basic-main-dropfiles.cpp#L247
